versions.changelog:
- Initial release: provides step-by-step, minimal installation guide for PowerMem memory with OpenClaw for personal users.
- No need for separate powermem.env configuration — automatically reuses the conversation model and keys configured in OpenClaw.
- Supports quick installation via a single command/script for Mac and Linux.
- Includes troubleshooting guidance for common setup problems.
- Designed for independent distribution; does not depend on other installation skills.
